LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Kabuto.label: kabuto
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Kabuto.description: A lacquered iron helmet with a flared neck guard of laced plates and gilded horns.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Domaru.label: do-maru
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Domaru.description: Rows of small lacquered scales laced together with silk cord. Lighter than plate, it lets a warrior move freely.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Kimono.label: kimono
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Kimono.description: A wrapped robe tied with a broad sash. Comfortable in summer and handsome at any ceremony.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Kamishimo.label: kamishimo
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Kamishimo.description: The formal dress of a retainer: a sleeveless jacket with stiff wide shoulders over pleated hakama trousers, marked with the house crest.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Jingasa.label: jingasa
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Jingasa.description: A wide, shallow cone hat of lacquered hardened leather, worn by foot soldiers and officials on the road. It keeps off sun, rain and a falling blow.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_ArmyCoat.label: Yamato army coat
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_ArmyCoat.description: A dark blue tunic with gold frogging across the chest and a red collar and hem.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_SteelHelmet.label: Yamato steel helmet
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_SteelHelmet.description: A round steel helmet with a short rim, painted in khaki, and the red sun on a white disc.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_FieldUniform.label: Yamato field uniform
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_FieldUniform.description: A khaki field tunic with red collar patches and shoulder boards, brass buttons and four pockets.
